scripts.verify:tauri: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:Path = \"$env:USERPROFILE\.cargo\bin;$env:Path\"; Push-Location frontend/src-tauri; cargo check; Pop-Location"
